_doc: A2.9/A2.9a: diario de Dex, capítulo 3 tal como es HOY (de mirar la luz del sótano al interruptor de emergencia: el capítulo 3 empieza con chapter_2_complete, aún en la azotea). Se reescribe en A3.5. Ver qa/README.md § Diario.

goals.text: Find where the humming comes from.

notes.text: The basement CRT runs on energy drink now. Next complaint: chip slot B7 is empty.
Hidden door behind the basement equipment rack. A whole server room. Still warm.
Pried a fused chip out of the dead AdrianAuctions rack. Might fit an old computer.
Emergency switch screen: 47.6062N, 122.3321W. Patient Zero Rehabilitation Clinic. The mountain path outside the lab goes that way.

hints: You saw the light. Now find the way down.
The roof hatch has three locks: a card reader, a keyhole and the vane's latch.
Grease and turn the vane. Then use the keycard and the terminal key on the roof hatch.
Something with an unreasonable amount of caffeine.
Use the energy drink from Adrian's office on the computer.
The equipment rack in the basement moves.
Big red switch. Glass in the way.
Something long and metal. The roof had one.
Use the antenna on the emergency switch.
Nothing between you and the switch now.
It says do not touch. Touch it.

anonIdle: Down here, nobody hears you call. I do. Rarely.
